about_the_game:
This Trick or Treat Pack includes 26 spooky-themed Clothing Items, 1 Ghost Pet, 1 Ghost Mount, and 9 different spooky-themed Furniture Items.

BOO! Just kidding, this isn’t scary at all! This Trick or Treat Pack is filled with items that will make it feel like every day is October 31st.

Pack includes:

  • Spooky Furniture Set including: a Table, a Rug, a Bed, a Wardrobe, a Couch, Chairs, End Tables, Cauldrons, and Stacked Pumpkin Decorations
  • Spooky Ghost Mount
  • Will’o, the Ghost Pet
  • 10 Spooky Outfit Sets including: 12 Hats, 4 Shirts, 6 Dresses, 2 Pants, and 2 Gloves
